hotels.title: Ultra-Luxe Playa Mujeres All-Inclusive Escape with SLS Style
hotels.description: Set on the pristine shores of Playa Mujeres, this contemporary beachfront retreat overlooks the Caribbean Sea and the Isla Mujeres coastline. Cancun’s Hotel Zone is a short drive away, while the ferry terminal offers easy access to island-hopping days. Suites feature private terraces, and several include swim-up access or ocean views. Dining spans international flavours at multiple restaurants, with a rooftop venue serving Japanese-inspired plates and cocktails. Guests can also visit the spa, fitness centre and lagoon-style pools. Nearby, El Meco Archaeological Site and the mangrove-lined Punta Sam area offer a glimpse of the region’s history and natural beauty
